arms.name: free_degree2_frozen
arms.role: baseline, already evaluated; do not refit

interpretation: NRMSE is RMSE divided by target RMS; thresholds are dimensionless training-RMS coefficient units. Tier A results compare function classes against a fixed teacher; they are not independent biological generalization.
not_run_reason: The teacher checkpoint (outputs/baseline_pc5/, SHA256 in outputs/logs/pc5_distillation_split_audit.json) and the distillation query data (outputs/distillation_pc5/) are git-ignored external artifacts and are not present in this repository, so no real-data refit can be executed or verified from the repository alone. This config freezes the design so the run is a single command once those artifacts are restored.
purpose: Issue #1/#2 follow-up: degree-3 free SINDy vs degree-2 frozen baseline, and potential-preserving arms, under the evaluation protocol in docs/evaluation_protocol.md (Tier A, fixed teacher, exploratory).
required_reporting: local (in-domain) and full-domain function NRMSE per arm, drift and G separately
active coefficient counts and support stability (bootstrap / threshold jitter)
Jacobian asymmetry in PC coordinates (src/diagnostics.py) per arm
day 2->6 simulation with failure mass retained: non-finite, >10R, finite-outside-domain reported separately, dt 0.05 and 0.025, seeds 202/203/204
fate composition including the failure category; no survivor-only conditioning
a negative or null difference between arms is a reportable result
selection: training/validation only, identical rules to configs/experiment_pc5.json (drift_validation_nrmse_max, selection_relative_error_tolerance); the existing test partition is already explored and must be labelled as such in every table (Tier A)
teacher: frozen 5-PC teacher of configs/experiment_pc5.json; do not retrain, do not substitute a projection of the 50-PC teacher
